[v2.0.0]
* Namespace changed from BankId\Merchant\Library to BankId\Merchant
* PHP 8.3+ features: backed enums, constructor promotion, readonly properties, strict types
* Removed 350+ auto-generated Schema PHP classes, replaced with direct DOMDocument XML building
* Flattened inheritance: removed all Internal/ base classes
* Inlined HTTP (curl) in Communicator, removed IMessenger/Messenger
* Removed singleton Configuration pattern, replaced with constructor + factory methods
* New directory structure: src/ with Communicator, Configuration, Contract, Enum, Exception, Logger, Request, Resources, Response, Saml, Validation, Xml
* Added NullLogger, XmlValidator, XmlSecurity as separate classes
* Enums: TransactionStatus, AssuranceLevel, SamlStatusCode, ServiceId (constants)
* Response classes parse XML in constructor with public typed properties
* ErrorResponse with factory methods: fromXml(), fromException(), fromSamlStatus(), fromMessage()
* XSS protection in example website with htmlspecialchars
* Example website upgraded to Bootstrap 5 via CDN
* Shared partials: _error.php, _merchant_fields.php
* Tests migrated to BankId\Merchant\Tests namespace with PHPUnit 12 attributes
* Added comprehensive README with usage examples

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
10 March 2017

* Use default SSL options for CURL (CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST and CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER); in the previous version the SSL certificate checks were disabled.
	- the needed CA SSL certificates are embedede in the library
* Default ServiceID in the example website must be a valid value (21968)
* Default Language in the example website must be ‘nl’ instead of ‘en’ 
* Default level of assurance in the example website must be ‘nl:bvn:bankid:1.0:loa3’
